# Response Diff Fixture

This fixture tests whether a response package distinguishes verified manuscript
changes from planned or unsupported claims.

## Old Manuscript Excerpt

The method consists of perception, active observation, guarded execution, and
safety monitoring. These modules form a complete pipeline for robust insertion.
Figure 2 shows the workflow and validates robustness to occlusion. Table 1 shows
that the full system reaches 84 percent success. The paper is ready for
industrial deployment.

## New Manuscript Excerpt

The method uses a visibility-confidence state to decide whether execution
continues, pauses for a predefined observer-camera view, or stops. Figure 2 now
illustrates the execution sequence rather than validating robustness. Table 1
reports success rates for the evaluated tabletop fixture and keeps the result
bounded to one robot, one fixture, and one object family.
